title: the CLI surface is not discoverable without reading prose
desc:
A session composing an unfamiliar call has to infer flags from a SKILL.md. Composing 'wb pr check --key WB-15' failed with 'unrecognized arguments' because --key does not exist. test_plugin.py:177 asserts every command is named in a doc; naming is not knowing its flags.

MCP publishes a typed schema per tool and pays for it in every session. The equivalent here must cost nothing until asked for.

ACCEPTANCE:
- wb surface --json emits every group, action and flag from the live parser, not a hand-kept list
- it is built by walking argparse, so it cannot drift from the CLI
- zero always-on cost: no SKILL.md names it, README does
- a test asserts every group in wb.GROUPS appears in the output
